# Kilian and Luetkepohl (2017) code subset

Copied from the book's companion code (`Code_Kilian`, Kilian and Luetkepohl, *Structural Vector Autoregressive Analysis*, Cambridge University Press, 2017), which also sits, gitignored, under `references/matlab_benchmarks/kilian_2017/`.

- `9/ml_nonrecursive/`: Keating (1992) non-recursive SVAR, Section 9.4; FRED data in the `.txt` files
- `5/figure5_2/`: Minnesota-prior BVAR, Figure 5.2; data in `Yraw.dat`
- Used by `tests/external_benchmarks/matlab/drivers/st_ref_svar_keating.m` and `st_ref_bvar_kl_minnesota.m`
- Files are unmodified; check the authors' redistribution terms before publishing this folder outside the repo
